title: For Families: When Independent Living Monthly Fees End
content:
When an Independent Living Residency Agreement ends, monthly fees run through a fee end date fixed by how the residency ended.

## The fee end date

- **After a resident notice:** the fee end date is the later of the vacate date and the notice end date, the notice end date being the notice date plus the move-out notice period of the apartment type in calendar days.
- **After a notice stating a move to a Larkspur assisted living or memory care residence, or an internal transfer recorded without notice:** the former clause fixing this fee end date as the later of the vacate date and the notice date plus the shortened internal transfer notice period is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for such moves.
- **On the death of the last occupant:** the fee end date is the later of the date belongings are removed (the vacate date) and the date of death plus the post-death fee days of the apartment type in calendar days, the date of death being the date of death on the customer profile.
- **After a discharge for nonpayment:** the fee end date is the vacate date.

## Charging through the fee end date

Fees are charged through the fee end date inclusive. Where the fee end date falls before the last day of a month already billed, the days after it are returned as a move-out proration credit referencing that month's full-month charge; where it falls in a month not yet billed, a prorated move-out charge covers the first of that month through the fee end date.

| Fee end date falls | Result |
|---|---|
| Inside a month already billed, before its last day | Days after the fee end date returned as a move-out proration credit referencing that month's full-month charge |
| In a month not yet billed | Prorated move-out charge from the first of that month through the fee end date |

## What must be on record

An ending recorded as death requires a date of death on the customer profile, and an ending recorded as a transfer requires the customer's Larkspur assisted living or memory care residency to be active; a family member's statement alone is not enough for either.

## Couples

The second person fee ends on the same fee end date unless the second occupant left earlier. When only one of two occupants dies or leaves, the residency does not end; the occupancy changes to single under the second-occupant rules.

## Examples (hypothetical dates, 30-day notice period, 14 post-death fee days)

- Notice dated March 10, apartment vacated March 25: the notice end date is April 9, which is later than the vacate date, so fees run through April 9.
- Last occupant died on May 3 (on the customer profile), belongings removed May 30: May 3 plus 14 days is May 17; the later date is May 30, so fees run through May 30.
- Last occupant died on May 3, belongings removed May 10: fees run through May 17.

superseded_clauses: After a notice stating a move to a Larkspur assisted living or memory care residence, and for an internal transfer recorded without notice, the fee end date is the later of the vacate date and the notice date plus internal_transfer_notice_days calendar days.
